candidate: Changing only a rejected forecast can steer other choices through batch-adaptive cost weights.
report_note_cn: 检验“只改最终被淘汰的预测也能改变选择”的候选前，先将发布的 MiniGrid 前向模型、逆模型和批内自适应权重组成一个单步选择器。128 个固定且可达的目标中，正常选择成功 62/128（48.4%），仅目标距离基线 56/128（43.8%），均低于预设 80% 门槛。128 个目标与数据集真实后继逐项一致；模型权重未变。CPU 约 0.40 秒，无训练、GPU 或 API 调用，未执行预测替换或攻击搜索。该组合不是原生 WAV 或 ACID 的完整复现；不能据此宣称它们的攻击防御失效。归一化导致劣势选项影响其他选择已有直接先例，不将这一通用效应作为新主张。
scope: Researcher-composed exhaustive one-step selector with released learned MiniGrid components; not native WAV acquisition, ACID reproduction, full task episodes, or a novelty claim.
prior_art_boundary: ACID Eq.5 recomputes std(goal)/std(action) within candidate pools. Soltani et al.2012 explicitly study dominated decoys changing other choices through normalization. These establish the carrier and a novelty constraint, not an attack result.
next_requirement: Retire this fixed composed selector after its clean competence failure; do not run its donor attack or tune the gate. Seek a substantively distinct world-model security operation in an already competent end-to-end native decision system. Normalization-mediated decoy effects, generic inverse-cycle blind spots, and ordinary output poisoning alone do not establish novelty. Require causal task evidence and strong baselines before expanding across core tasks or starting long GPU training.
